activity_search.scope: Updated PR/issue search, not all arbitrary branches or an exhaustive history census

later_delta_rule: Unchanged full SHA needs no ancestry inference. After an advance, check ancestry then compare both exact endpoint trees; preserve previous per-file verdicts only at their unchanged dependency scope.
publication_receipt: Recorded after publication in the PR closing comment and outer delivery receipt, not guessed in this prepublication file.
write_boundary: Append pass4 to the review branch only. No main, research branch, canonical/formal, workflow or settings change.
